scope: Selected high-impact paper and pinned-source claims with explicit qualifications. Supplied PDF versions govern paper claims; the code snapshot is separately identified. This is not an exhaustive automatic proof of every prose sentence.

claims.fact: Base policy: state30 + previous action12 + latent8 ->12 target joint positions; privileged environment17 ->latent8.
claims.qualification: The article does not expand the ambiguous mass/position subdimension wording into an invented17-element list.

claims.fact: State:12 joint positions,12 velocities,roll/pitch,4 binary foot contacts. Deployed PD gains55/.8, desired joint velocity0.
claims.qualification: This is the original A1 interface; not an arbitrary robot-control head.

claims.fact: Adaptation sees50-step history and is trained on rollouts driven by its own predicted latent.
claims.qualification: History formula follows III-B; sampling/dispatch pairing must be explicit. Fig2 and supplementary notation differ.

claims.fact: Base policy100Hz, adaptation10Hz; history about.5s.
claims.qualification: Article now explicitly identifies the simultaneous simulation dt=.025 statement and100Hz policy frequency as inconsistent without a resolved simulator/control-step contract.

claims.fact: Base MLP hidden128; encoder256/128; embedding32 then three temporal convolutions(32,32,8,4),(32,32,5,1),(32,32,5,1).
claims.qualification: 50->11->7->3 and96->8 is conditional no-padding arithmetic, not a claim about an unverified original source checkout.

claims.fact: PPO15000x80000=1.2B transitions; adaptation1000x80000=80M; learning rate.0005; reported24h+3h on a one-GPU desktop.
claims.qualification: Training costs are not deployment hardware requirements.

claims.fact: Simulation3 initialized policies x1000 episodes;indoor hardware generally5 trials per method,only2 trials then report failure if a method fails drastically;outdoor stair descent70%,cement/pebble80%.
claims.qualification: Different physical trial protocols and small sample sizes remain visible.

claims.fact: Relative action trajectories share the current end-effector anchor; pose history and inter-gripper pose are observations.
claims.qualification: The article distinguishes the SE(3) increment illustration from the component delta convention in a later source snapshot.

claims.fact: Fisheye, side mirrors with digital reflection/swap, continuous gripper information and kinematic filtering support transferable data.
claims.qualification: Filtering demonstrations does not prove closed-loop collision or torque feasibility.

claims.fact: Observation streams align at image capture times; commands are sent ahead and outdated target actions discarded.
claims.qualification: The deadline-ceiling example explicitly accepts equality; the pinned source method has a strict greater-than filter.

claims.fact: Cup/tossing histories2/2 and action horizon6; frequencies10/20Hz and relative execution speed.5x/1x; DDIM50 training-time noise steps and16 inference steps.
claims.qualification: These axes are distinct; RTC pi0.5 five-step inference is another configuration.

claims.fact: UR5 cup relative20/20, delta16/20, absolute5/20; same checkpoint on Franka FR2:18/20, two joint-limit failures.
claims.qualification: Absolute baseline calibration error is retained; no general ordering of all absolute versus relative policies is claimed.

claims.fact: Cup success includes handle orientation within15degrees left; tossing105/120 vs69/120; folding14/20 vs6/20.
claims.qualification: Tossing counts individual objects; other task episodes and substep scores are not pooled.

claims.fact: Three demonstrators,12person-hours,1400demonstrations,30places,15cups;unseen-environment43/60,split28/40seen cups and15/20novel cups. Same-backbone narrow-data baseline0/10at each of the2environments,total0/20.
claims.qualification: Seen cups are still tested in new environments;the baseline uses20rather than60 evaluations. Dataset amount and diversity are not separately identified.

claims.fact: MoCap benchmark:7 single-gripper and7 bimanual tasks; per-gripper ATE6.1mm/3.5deg; inter-gripper RPE10.1mm/.8deg.
claims.qualification: Means, reference definitions and objects of evaluation differ; these are not per-action worst errors or robot tracking guarantees.

claims.fact: d=floor(delta/Delta t) under a model ignoring sub-timestep synchronization; schedule d<=s<=H-d.
claims.qualification: The article labels its deadline ceiling and distinct d_work/d_deadline as constructed extensions with explicit event conventions.

claims.fact: Guidance: final estimate Ahat=A+(1-tau)v; VJP J^T diag(W)(Y-Ahat); clipped coefficient with r_tau_squared=(1-tau)^2/(tau^2+(1-tau)^2).
claims.qualification: The negative weighted-loss gradient, W versus W-squared and endpoint coefficient limits are independently derived checks.

claims.fact: Eq5 transition is c_i*(exp(c_i)-1)/(e-1),c_i=(H-s-i)/(H-s-d+1).
claims.qualification: Initial new-draft omission corrected after visual PDF/HTML and official-source comparison. Fixed c=.5 regression and source/Decimal parity added.

claims.fact: Committed prefix,editable overlap,new future; max recent delay buffer Q forecasts the next delay. Algorithm1 takes initial A_init and d_init; the overlap timeline assumes an initial running chunk.
claims.qualification: Guidance is not a numerical hard clamp or a hard upper bound on future latency.

claims.fact: 12 Kinetix tasks,6 real tasks; simulated H8 and2048 rollouts per evaluation; real H50,20ms,5 denoising steps,76ms baseline/97ms RTC plus10-20ms LAN; added100/200ms delay.
claims.qualification: Force-control simulation and position-control hardware have different waiting behavior; task success, throughput and substep scores stay distinct.

claims.fact: Fixed prior controller plus learned residual; reward decomposition does not decouple robot-object dynamics; TD3 is the learning algorithm used.
claims.qualification: Induced MDP, scaling, clipping and actor-chain examples are article analyses, not claims about unreported original hyperparameters.

claims.fact: Algorithm1 generates residual plus exploration, adds the baseline, and records the learning action.
claims.qualification: The complete replay contract also needs reward,termination/truncation and any hidden controller state.

claims.fact: Simulation uses Cartesian position control and full force/torque observations; Eq6 x_t is the held block position. Real setup uses joint impedance,z-force and camera object state; Eq7 x_t is end-effector position and adds side-block position/yaw penalties.
claims.qualification: The block starts already grasped; this is not a full perception/grasp/assembly pipeline.

claims.fact: Aligned20/20 both; misaligned15/20 residual vs2/20 prior,side-block rotations +/-20degrees;manual scoring;about8000 samples/3hours.
claims.qualification: Hardware sample count and timing remain task-specific; simulation seeds do not become hardware replicate counts.

claims.fact: V-D uses a policy pretrained by deep RL in the fixed-block simulation as pi_H. Sim-initialized comparison uses fixed side blocks,3 seeds,and fewer than1000 real steps.
claims.qualification: Fixed prior may itself be learned; initialization wording does not imply only loading residual-network weights. This differs from the moving-side-block8000-sample experiment; no acceleration ratio is inferred.

claims.fact: Eq6 maps end-effector points through X*Gamma(q) into the environment SDF; binary contacts do not measure exact contact position.
claims.qualification: The article fixes X=^S T_B using the transformation chain, rather than relying on ambiguous frame-direction prose.

claims.fact: Distance is minimum SIGNED SDF over a finite end-effector surface point cloud; noncontact weight epsilon only below -delta_P.
claims.qualification: Exact sphere and planar-circle calculations isolate signs and sampling; no voxel-grid or physical collision guarantee is inferred.

claims.fact: Printed Eq7 exponent uses2*sigma_P while prefactor uses sigma_P_squared; IV-B and VII-A.2 variance terminology differs.
claims.qualification: Article preserves the printed kernel, separately defines consistent STD sigma and checks both normalized weight conventions.

claims.fact: Each round perturbs particles,evaluates the current sliding batch,normalizes and resamples.
claims.qualification: Pre-resampling weighted and post-resampling equal estimators are distinguished; old weights are not applied a second time.

claims.fact: CoACD segments and max-min angular normal diversity select an action; try next feasible candidate or switch segment.
claims.qualification: This is a heuristic,not explicit expected entropy maximization. Opposite normals can add no rank.

claims.fact: Confidence,stability and consistency all pass for5 consecutive rounds; Eq12 contact rejects d>delta_E,noncontact rejects d<=-delta_E; Eq13 grows on C&&!V,shrinks on S&&V.
claims.qualification: One-sided stopping predicates differ from the squared contact likelihood. Mean rotation and mixed-unit thresholds require explicit implementation contracts.

claims.fact: Simulation initial translation +/-15cm,rotation +/-.15rad,100000 particles,5 initial guesses per object; real Franka has a protective printed cover and threshold contact detection.
claims.qualification: These are experiment conditions rather than a global convergence basin.

claims.fact: TableI times2.7,2.9,5.5,7.8,12.4s for L60,100,600,1000,2000; TableII translationcm,rotation10^-2rad;10 repeats per table/shelf condition.
claims.qualification: These are particle evaluation times,not servo periods. Reported +/- terms are not worst-case bounds; TableII values are used rather than contradictory prose action-count approximations.

claims.fact: Real table mean5.3mm/.63deg;real shelf7.2mm/.85deg;Baxter-shaped environment example has no ground truth.
claims.qualification: Baxter visualization is not pooled into quantitative absolute-error results; beanbag shape is modeled as rigid geometry.

claims.fact: Fig2 simulation ordinate is success rate,hardware ordinate average return;Fig4 perturbation comparisons use final average return.
claims.qualification: Article keeps these metrics distinct and does not turn a return difference into a success-rate percentage.

claims.fact: HD2 uses155deg fisheye and raw policy images;HD4 inertial-monocular ORB-SLAM3 recovers metric scale;HD5 continuously tracks finger width with fiducials and uses soft finger deformation.
claims.qualification: Transient inertial support does not remove visual texture requirements;continuous width is not an independently measured exact contact force.

claims.fact: VII throughput compares three methods over15minutes,including resets,randomization and robot faults;cup UMI>3x SpaceMouse and48% barehand;tossing64% barehand,SpaceMouse no successful demonstration.
claims.qualification: Paper-reported short-protocol ratios,not current hardware performance or sustainable long-run collection throughput;offline recovery,filtering and training remain separate.

claims.fact: Dishwashing has7 dependent stages,258 demonstrations including explicit recovery from additional ketchup,CLIP ViT-B/16 policy14/20 and unpretrained ResNet-34 baseline0/10.
claims.qualification: Recovery is supported by demonstration data,not deployment weight updates;architecture and pretraining both change in this baseline.

claims.fact: Pure helper returns original interpolator for target<=curr_time;controller branches still record last requested time. RTDE andWSG pass speed bounds;Franka branch does not. Constructed x=.01 at4.01s,targetx=1 at4.3s,maxspeed.2 produces endpoint8.96s.
claims.qualification: Source branch replay only,not a running IPC/servo/controller or physical hardware result;speed arguments can differ across backends.

claims.fact: Target-policy smoothing noise is clipped and chosen independently of the exploration policy; it is sampled for the critic target, not sent as the current physical action.
claims.qualification: Added explanatory distinction without attributing the supporting paper’s numerical hyperparameters to the residual-RL robot experiment.

claims.fact: TableII table(sim) actions21.8±5.8,table(real)17.2±6.5; nearby VII-B prose instead summarizes table actions as30 real to20 simulation.
claims.qualification: Direct page-raster review confirms the mismatch. Article retains exact table entries and flags the prose/table inconsistency without inferring an action-count acceleration ratio.

constructed_analyses: Weighted-loss VJP and clipped coefficient endpoints
Residual induced MDP,relabeling,scaled/clipped actor gradients,linear scalar stability and bounded-tanh local instability versus ultimate boundedness
Known point-plane rank,infinite-domain covariance,finite prior truncation,equicorrelated measurement fusion
Point-sampling/SDF approximation bound and signed circle counterexample
Pinned controller-branch clock translation and pure trajectory retiming under explicitly constructed finite-speed limits
